name: Takimoto Hifumi
source:
Age: 20+

A character designer and a member in Aoba's team. She is extremely shy when she tries talking with others and often stutters but turns instantly into a chatterbox when chatting using e-mail (she even adds emoticons at the end of her lines). Secretly enjoys cosplaying.
